events.message: Light ray. A ray is a model of a path along which light travels, not a solid thread.
No new combination here.
No new combination here.
Placed.
Inverted image. Rays from the top and bottom of the scene cross at the aperture. The projected image is inverted.
No new combination here.
Camera obscura. An enclosed dark space with a small opening forms an image of an outside scene. The model can be a room or a portable box.
Optical experiment. The arrangement can be repeated and varied. A convincing image is evidence to investigate, not an automatic verdict on every theory of vision.
Refraction model. A model of how light changes direction across materials. This simplified card omits the full angle-dependent law.
No new combination here.
Focused image. A suitably arranged lens brings rays from scene points to corresponding points on a screen.
No new combination here.
No new combination here.
Image-forming model. This model connects light paths to positions in an image. It does not attempt to model perception in the brain.
The atlas travels to a renaissance painting workshop; earlier objects stay in their previous collections unless still useful. We collect the things needed for this scene along the way.
No new combination here.
Projection construction. Projection construction: a playable abstraction using image-forming model and picture plane.
Vanishing point. In this construction, a family of parallel lines receding from the picture plane converges at a point.
Perspective grid. A geometric guide to constructing depth from a chosen viewpoint; not the only legitimate way to depict space.
Perspective drawing. The plan is projected into a view from one chosen eye position.
Scaled architectural view. Measured proportions connect the imagined view to the courtyard plan. It can guide comparison without claiming a painted view is a complete survey.
Paint. Pigment supplies color; a binder holds it together and attaches it to a surface. Different media afford different marks.

playerReport: Voluntary stop in painting workshop after optics goals and scaled architectural view. 24 attempts, 15 accepted, 13 creations, 3 hints. Enjoyed pinhole placement leading to inverted image, camera obscura, then optical experiment; this had a concrete causal thread. Perspective construction chain was legible after one failed parallel-lines plus horizon guess, but then felt routine. Generic failures for aperture plus dark room, barrier plus aperture, image plus protocol, and paint plus drawing or light study do not distinguish an incomplete setup from a bad concept. Focused image plus light ray felt like an abstract naming gate after ray already produced refraction. Projection construction explanation merely restates its ingredients. I stopped because I was losing interest in finding the prescribed intermediate noun for the painting; I wanted a visible consequence or richer feedback instead. No claim about human enjoyment or graphical interface. Did not see chance stage. Blind player protocol maintained; no source or scenario read.
